gpt.text:
You can run those three commands in the order shown. I can’t execute them from here, but I can tell you what to expect and what to paste back so I can help choose/triage the next iteration.

## 1) Run module-level autopilot + select best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```
**Purpose:** explores candidate module tweaks from `module_registry.yaml`, runs evals, and (with `--select-best`) promotes the best-performing module configuration into the “current” slot (depending on how your repo wires champion selection).

**After it finishes, paste back:**
- The console summary table (means/mins per candidate)
- Any file path it reports as “selected/promoted/best”
- Any failures/timeouts

## 2) Run system-level autopilot
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
**Purpose:** evaluates end-to-end “system candidates” defined in `system_candidates.yaml` (often combinations of modules, prompts, routing, etc.).

**After it finishes, paste back:**
- The ranked results (mean/min and whatever other metrics you track)
- Which candidate (if any) beat the current champion on both tuning and lockbox (or your gating rule)
- Links/paths to generated reports (often under `baseline/reports/` or a run folder)

## 3) Generate the “next fix” plan
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**Purpose:** produces a targeted fix list based on latest results and registry metadata.

**After it finishes, paste back:**
- `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` contents (or the top sections + any “action items”)

---

## Notes based on your handoff
- Current champion:
  - tuning mean/min: **1.9038 / 0.4315**
  - lockbox mean/min: **1.7925 / 1.1337**
- There are **no PASS candidates** right now, so step (1) and (2) are the ones that can create a new challenger set; step (3) helps focus remediation if everything regresses or fails a constraint (often lockbox min).

---

## If you want me to sanity-check selection criteria
Tell me your promotion rule, e.g.:
- “Must improve lockbox mean and not reduce lockbox min below X”
- “Maximize tuning mean subject to lockbox min ≥ champion lockbox min”
- etc.

If you paste the outputs from (1) and (2), I can recommend whether to accept the selected best, rerun with different seeds, or adjust the candidate space.
